mainEntity.name: What site preparations are needed before installing an outdoor pizza oven?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, adequate site preparation is crucial for safety and functionality. This typically includes a level, stable concrete pad or foundation capable of supporting the oven's weight, which can be considerable. Depending on your chosen oven and desired features, you might also need gas lines, electrical outlets, or dedicated ventilation. Hometelligent assists with identifying and implementing all necessary site preparations.
